integrity: The infinite statement is supported by a complete case proof. A standalone exhaustive checker independently verified the classification, all coefficients, totals, and minimum layers for \(3\le n\le8\). No independence beyond the stated self-review is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Ordinary power domination only; crown graphs with \(n\ge3\). The inaccessible portion of the closest 2019 same-object paper leaves a residual literature risk. Exhaustive computation is supplementary and covers only \(3\le n\le8\).
title: Power domination polynomial of crown graphs
